title: Fixing Sign Shop Mistakes Without Losing Clients
description: Real talk with VI Print Services about what every sign shop owner eventually faces — mistakes. Learn how to handle errors professionally and turn potential disasters into opportunities.
keyTakeaways: Own the mistake immediately — never blame the client
Have a clear process for handling errors before they happen
Communication speed matters more than perfection
Document mistakes to prevent repeat issues
A well-handled mistake can create a more loyal customer
